title: 第29章 道气阵，上古符文
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
“道、气、阵……”

    当这几个字被张建国和金世昌两位教授辨认出来时，整个直播间再次掀起了轩然大波。

    如果说之前发现“顾长青”和“长生”的名字，还只是将矛头指向了一个传说中的“仙人”。

    那么现在，“道”、“气”、“阵”这些字的出现，则是从理论基础上，证实了一个超凡体系的存在！

    【道！气！阵！这不就是修仙小说里的三要素吗？道法、练气、阵法！齐活了！】

    【我人麻了，我一直以为这些都是网文作者编出来骗我们钱的，搞了半天，人家那叫纪实文学！】

    【所以，我们老祖宗真的会修仙？那我们现在为什么不会了？难道是灵气枯竭了？】

    【楼上的，看看这地宫，看看这百里死域！说不定就是因为这个叫顾长青的哥们儿把灵气都吸光了，我们才变成了末法时代！】

    【真相了！破案了！原来我们成不了仙，都是因为这姓顾的太能卷了！】

    弹幕的画风，在短短几分钟内，就从考古探秘，一路跑偏到了玄幻修仙，甚至开始探讨起了末法时代的成因。

    演播厅里，物理学家陈振博士的脸色变了又变。

    作为一名坚定的唯物主义科学家，他感觉自己几十年来建立的科学信仰，正在被这些神秘的古代符文，一下又一下地敲得粉碎。

    “张老，金老，这些……真的都是文字吗？”

    他忍不住问道，声音里带着他自己都没察出觉的虚心，“有没有可能，只是一些碰巧长得像汉字的……装饰性图案？”

    他还在试图用科学的逻辑，做最后的挣扎。

    “装饰？”

    金世昌看了他一眼，摇了摇头，这一次，他的眼神里没有了之前的争锋相对，反而多了怜悯，在看一个固执地不愿承认太阳存在的盲人。

    “陈博士，你睁大眼睛看清楚。”

    金老先生指着屏幕上那些被拓印下来的符文，“你看到这些符文的排列方式了吗？它们看似杂乱，实则暗合规律。你看这里，这几个字，‘乾’、‘坤’、‘震’、‘巽’，它们对应的方位，正好是八卦中的天、地、雷、风。”

    “还有这里，这七个符文连在一起，构成的形状，与天上的北斗七星遥相呼-应！”

    “这每一个符文，都不是孤立存在的！它们相互连接，相互影响，以这口玉棺为中心，构成了一个完整、复杂、并且在自行运转的……系统！”

    金世昌的声音越来越高亢，他站起身，用不容置疑的语气，说出了自己的最终结论。

    “这，就是一个上古禁断大阵！它的作用，只有一个——守护！或者说，是滋养！用这整个地宫，这漫天星辰的力量，去滋养玉棺里的东西！”

    “轰！”

    金老的话，如同一道惊雷，劈在了所有人的脑海里。

    滋养？

    用一个运转了两千多年的大阵，去滋养棺材里的东西？

    那棺材里，到底是什么？

    是人？

    是物？

    还是……

    一个正在等待孵化的……

    神？

    “我……我不信……”

    陈振博士喃喃自语，他拼命地摇头，“这不科学……能量守恒定律呢？如果它真的运转了两千年，它的能量源在哪里？这么庞大的能量，不可能凭空产生！”
content_en:
"Tao, Qi, Formation..."

    When these words were recognized by two professors, Zhang Jianguo and Jin Shichang, the entire live broadcast room once again caused an uproar.

    If the names of "Gu Changqing" and "Changsheng" were discovered before, they only pointed the finger at a legendary "immortal".

    So now, the appearance of the words "Tao", "Qi" and "Array" confirms the existence of an extraordinary system on a theoretical basis!

    【road! gas! Array! Aren't these the three elements in immortality novels? Taoism, Qi training, and formations! Let’s live together! 】

    [I feel numb. I always thought that these were made up by Internet writers to defraud us of our money. I have been doing this for a long time. They call it documentary literature! 】

    [So, our ancestors really know how to cultivate immortality? So why can't we do it now? Could it be that the spiritual energy is exhausted? 】

    [People upstairs, look at this underground palace, look at this hundred-mile dead zone! Maybe it’s because this guy named Gu Changqing sucked up all the spiritual energy that we have become the Age of Ending Law! 】

    【The truth is out! Case solved! It turns out that we can't become immortals because this guy named Gu is too good at curling up! 】

    The style of barrage, in just a few minutes, went all the way from archaeological exploration to fantasy cultivation, and even began to explore the causes of the Age of Ending Dharma.

    In the studio, the face of physicist Dr. Chen Zhen changed again and again.

    As a staunch materialist scientist, he felt that the scientific beliefs he had established over decades were being shattered one after another by these mysterious ancient runes.

    "Mr. Zhang, Mr. Jin, are these... really all words?"

    He couldn't help but ask, with a humility in his voice that he didn't even notice, "Is it possible that it's just some... decorative patterns that happen to look like Chinese characters?"

    He is still trying to use scientific logic to make the final struggle.

    "Decoration?"

    Jin Shichang glanced at him and shook his head. This time, there was no confrontation in his eyes, but more compassion, looking at a blind man who stubbornly refused to admit the existence of the sun.

    "Dr. Chen, open your eyes and see clearly."

    Mr. Jin pointed to the rubbed runes on the screen, "Have you seen the arrangement of these runes? They seem chaotic, but they actually follow a pattern. Look here, these words, 'Qian', 'Kun', 'Zhen', and 'Xun', their corresponding directions are exactly the heaven, earth, thunder, and wind in the Bagua."

    "And here, these seven runes are connected together to form a shape that echoes the Big Dipper in the sky!"

    "Each of these runes does not exist in isolation! They are connected to each other and influence each other. With this jade coffin as the center, they form a complete, complex, and self-operating... system!"

    Jin Shichang's voice became louder and louder. He stood up and expressed his final conclusion in a tone that left no room for doubt.

    "This is an ancient forbidden formation! It has only one function - to protect! In other words, to nourish! Use the entire underground palace and the power of the stars in the sky to nourish the things in the jade coffin!"

    "Boom!"

    Jin Lao's words were like thunder, striking everyone's minds.

    nourish?

    Use a large formation that has been operating for more than two thousand years to nourish the things in the coffin?

    What is in that coffin?

    Is it a human?

    Is it a thing?

    Or...

    One waiting to be hatched...

    God?

    "I...I don't believe it..."

    Dr. Chen Zhen murmured to himself, shaking his head desperately, "This is unscientific... What about the law of conservation of energy? If it has really been running for two thousand years, where is its energy source? Such a huge amount of energy cannot be generated out of thin air!"
title_en: Chapter 29 Dao Qi Formation, Ancient Runes
